{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Biden and Vice President Harris launched a $27 billion national financing network as part of the Greenhouse Gas Reduction fund.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The $27 billion national financing network is intended to help ensure new climate and clean energy projects can get financed across America, particularly in communities historically left behind and overburdened by pollution.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The $27 billion national financing network will ensure communities across the country have access to the capital they need to participate in and benefit from a cleaner, more sustainable economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The $27 billion national financing network is intended to slash harmful climate pollution.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The $27 billion national financing network is intended to improve air quality.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The $27 billion national financing network is intended to lower energy costs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The $27 billion national financing network is intended to create good-paying jobs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The climate law makes major investments in long-overdue clean water and sanitation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The climate law launched a Clean Ports program to help ease the impact of air pollution around ports and airports.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Clean Ports program is intended to help ease the impact of air pollution around ports and airports, where thousands of trucks move goods in and out, often through neighborhoods experiencing distress as a result of historic disinvestment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The climate law invests in clean public transit, connecting communities that have been isolated or disconnected by infrastructure and development to jobs, healthcare, education and opportunities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Millions of trees will be planted under the climate law, deploying a nature-based solution to combat the urban heat island effect by cooling streets and easing the deadly impact of extreme heat on people living and working in these areas.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The President's Executive Order on Environmental Justice for All will continue to be implemented.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Legislative options to further advance environmental justice will be sought.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
